payload.title: A gold-corpus defect without defect_class is scored class-agnostic by measure_discovery_recall (any overlapping report hits it, so recall is overstated) while feed_dev_misses raises KeyError on the same defect when missed, and no entry point validates the gold case shape that the docstrings promise.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/role_fitness.py:339-342 (docstring: gold defects always name a class; only the zoo's labels carry none)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/role_fitness.py:345-348 (a defect with no defect_class key skips the class comparison entirely)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/role_fitness.py:414-416 (measure_discovery_recall hands cases straight to the fold with no shape check)
aria-kernel/tests/test_discovery_scoring_one_matcher.py:156-164 (pins that a classless gold defect is hit by a report of any class; no pin refuses it)
payload.rule_violated: One owner of a fact: the two gold-side callers of the one fold (measure_discovery_recall and feed_dev_misses) disagree on what a valid gold defect is; the SPEC ruling 'class only when the defect names one' is meant for the zoo's labels, not for a data error in the gold corpus.
payload.notes: A DEV case whose defect lacks defect_class (a data error in whatever producer later loads the corpus) makes _defect_is_hit skip the class test (role_fitness.py:345-348). Probe at this revision: one classless gold defect plus an overlapping report of class 'anything' gives hits 1, recall 1.0 and Wilson [0.2065, 1.0], with no error; the same defect with no report is a miss, and the feed then raises KeyError 'defect_class' at role_fitness.py:490, aborting the DEV miss feed. So a data error widens recall quietly when the defect is found and crashes the feed when it is missed. No producer passes cases yet (ARIA-HIGH-758), so no wrong number is recorded today. Close condition: Validate the gold case shape once on the gold side (defect_id, path, integer lines, defect_class) and have both measure_discovery_recall and feed_dev_misses refuse a defect without defect_class by name, as score_zoo_discovery already refuses id disagreement; the zoo adapter keeps classless defects by calling the fold directly. A test passes a classless gold defect to both entry points and expects the same named refusal; the pin at aria-kernel/tests/test_discovery_scoring_one_matcher.py:156 is rewritten to the zoo path. Verified at origin/main a81bfa2d6.
